agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: The authoritative clone ended in a whiteout with Eelektrik still active; this policy bundle is not qualified for live execution.
At Bushtank 4/57 after two Razor Leaf uses against Eelektrik, the policy selected Bite instead of the available Croakatoa pivot; this was the earliest causal divergence that exhausted the team.

resolution.observed: One disposable replay from the attached state switched Croakatoa in and reached a stable command menu after Eelektrik Mega Drain without a faint.
resolution.fix: After two verified Bushtank Razor Leafs, forbid further Bushtank moves and prefer Croakatoa.

findings.summary: The reusable Croakatoa Eelektrik rule referenced move 609 (Nuzzle), which is absent from the prepared set; ROM data verifies move 410 is Vacuum Wave.

resolution.observed: ROM move lookup returned 609=Nuzzle and 410=Vacuum Wave; the executable strategy now uses 410.
resolution.fix: Corrected the additive strategy record without deleting its historical evidence.

findings.summary: After Croakatoa's successful fresh-entry Fake Out, the policy pivoted to Birdlaw; bounded replays from the same state showed Eelektrik Shock Wave immediately fainted Birdlaw but did not affect Rampage or Lildozer.

resolution.observed: Two bounded replays from the attached state reached stable command menus after switching Rampage or Lildozer; both ignored Shock Wave, unlike Birdlaw.
resolution.fix: Prefer the Ground pivot after Fake Out and forbid the Birdlaw pivot while that pivot is available.

findings.summary: Rampage was spent as the Ponyta pivot and reached only 21 HP, so the later Eelektrik converter line lacked a healthy Ground reserve; the corrected policy preserves Rampage through Ponyta and chooses Ohmnomnom there.

resolution.observed: The corrected policy certificate at the attached state vetoes Rampage and Birdlaw and selects Ohmnomnom; a bounded Bulldoze-then-Ohm replay preserved Rampage at full HP.
resolution.fix: Reserve Rampage for Eelektrik/Dustox and keep it out of the Ponyta branch.

findings.summary: The loss consumed 27 verified actions and 9 switches; the excess tempo was downstream of the Eelektrik pivot errors, so shorter-line qualification remains required.
All 27 actions were RAM-verified; the decisive costs were Bushtank, Birdlaw, Ohmnomnom, Lildozer, Croakatoa, and Rampage faints rather than a tooling mismatch.

correct_choices: Bushtank Razor Leaf opened Bibarel and Ohmnomnom Spark completed the Bibarel phase.
Lildozer handled the initial Ponyta damage and Rampage Smack Down correctly grounded Ponyta when used.
Croakatoa Fake Out was correctly reserved for a verified fresh Eelektrik entry and did flinch it.
agent_review.next_test: Run clone 2 only after this review is accepted; verify the corrected policy preserves Rampage through Ponyta, pivots Bushtank after two Eelektrik Razor Leafs, and uses Croakatoa Fake Out followed by the verified Ground reserve.
